2187-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.

Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.

When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

When you cast that spell, Flux Channeler triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Grim Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Grim Monolith from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Grim Monolith.
Repeat.

Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
1978-3430-5793-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

2557-3129-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.

If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.

Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.

Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
